verdict.rationale: Cactus clearly has public GitHub repositories and mentions an "open-source package". However, the evidence pack never documents a contribution process: no contributing guidelines, PR or review workflow, contributor recognition, or path to collaborator or maintainer status. Being open source is adjacent to the story, not evidence that it delivers it, so the applicable axis gets "none".

support.subject: As a developer, I can contribute code and become a recognized collaborator through the project's open-source process
